research.text: Sunny C. Lin, PhD, MS, is an assistant professor in the Washington University School of Medicine whose research aims to improve healthcare for vulnerable populations with a special emphasis on older adults with dementia. Her research explores the impact of policy reform and health information technology on healthcare utilization, costs, and the quality of care.
